auth.basic_hint: Clients receive 401 Unauthorized until they send a valid username and password. Passwords are stored as argon2 hashes. Leave the password empty to keep the current password.
auth.user_file_hint: Path to a file on disk containing username:password or username:hash pairs (one per line, e.g. /etc/r3v3rs3/users.txt). Supports plaintext and Argon2 hashes. Automatically reloaded when the file changes.
auth.bearer_hint: Clients receive 401 Unauthorized until they send Authorization: Bearer with a valid token. Use a random value of at least 16 characters, e.g. openssl rand -hex 32. Tokens are stored as SHA-256 digests. Leave the token empty to keep the current token.

auth.forward_hint: r3v3rs3 sends a GET request with the client headers and X-Forwarded-Method, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Uri and X-Forwarded-For to this URL. A 2xx response lets the request through and copies the listed headers to the upstream request. Any other response, for example a login redirect, is sent to the client.
auth.oidc_endpoints_required: Either Issuer URL or both Authorization URL and Token URL are required
auth.oidc_hint: r3v3rs3 authenticates clients directly against an OpenID Connect or OAuth 2.0 provider. Unauthenticated clients are redirected to the provider's sign-in page. Upon successful authentication, r3v3rs3 issues an HttpOnly session cookie and forwards user email to upstream in X-Forwarded-User and X-Forwarded-Email headers.
auth.session_hint: Clients sign in with an r3v3rs3 panel account at /.r3v3rs3/auth/login below the route path. Browsers without a session are redirected to the sign-in page. Other requests without a session receive 401 Unauthorized. The HttpOnly session cookie is valid only for the host where the client signed in. A POST request to /.r3v3rs3/auth/logout ends the session.

http_form.access_list_hint: The IP filter and the authentication of the selected access list replace those of the proxy.
http_form.allow_hint: When set, only clients in these IP addresses or CIDR blocks can access the proxy. Separate several entries with commas: a single address such as 10.0.0.5 becomes a /32, so CIDR blocks and single addresses mix freely, for example 192.168.0.0/16, 10.0.0.5, 2001:db8::/32.
http_form.body_limit_hint: The largest request body of every route in bytes. Set it to 0 to disable the limit. A request with a larger Content-Length receives 413 Payload Too Large before authentication. A body without Content-Length is counted while it goes to the upstream server, and the client receives 413 when it passes the limit before the upstream server answers.
http_form.bot_blocker_hint: Blocks automated AI crawlers, scrapers and aggressive bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider, CCBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) with 403 Forbidden.
http_form.grpc_web_hint: Translates browser gRPC-Web requests and streams for upstream gRPC backends, frames trailers into the response stream, and handles CORS preflight.
http_form.cache_hint: Stores GET responses in memory and sends them without contacting the upstream server. The cache follows Cache-Control, Expires, Vary, ETag and Last-Modified, and does not store private responses or responses with Set-Cookie. Default TTL applies to responses without a lifetime. With 0, such a response is stored only when it has a validator. Use Purge in the proxy list to remove the stored responses.
http_form.compression_hint: Compresses upstream responses for clients that accept a selected encoding. When a client accepts several encodings equally, the first selected encoding wins. Responses that are already encoded, partial, smaller than the minimum size, not in the media types or marked Cache-Control: no-transform are not compressed. Select no encoding to disable compression.
http_form.adaptive_compression_hint: Automatically adjusts compression quality based on response payload size and dynamically adapts minimum size threshold for text and JSON.
http_form.precompressed_hint: Serves pre-compressed static assets directly with zero CPU overhead.
http_form.compression_dictionaries_hint: Pre-shared dictionaries for dcz and dcb encoding, saving 80-95% bandwidth on repeated JSON/HTML patterns.
http_form.concurrency_limit_hint: Simultaneous in-flight requests allowed per client IP or request header (e.g. API key). Clients exceeding the limit receive 429 Too Many Requests. Set Max to 0 to disable the limit.
http_form.count_range: {name} must be a whole number from 0 to {max}
http_form.countries_hint: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. TR, US, DE). Requires GeoIP database configured in Settings.
http_form.deny_hint: Clients in these IP addresses or CIDR blocks receive 403 Forbidden. Denied addresses take precedence over allowed addresses. Separate several entries with commas, for example 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.7.
http_form.dry_run_client_ip_hint: Simulate client IP for allow/deny filter checks
http_form.dry_run_desc: Simulate incoming requests against current unsaved rules to verify route matching, rewrites and access controls.
http_form.dry_run_form_invalid: Please fix form errors before simulating rules.
http_form.dry_run_url_hint: Enter a full URL (e.g. https://example.com/api/users) or path (e.g. /api/users)
http_form.enable_mirror: Mirror the Requests of This Route
http_form.fixed_response_hint: r3v3rs3 answers every request of this route itself. The IP filter, the rate limit, the redirect rules and authentication run first.
http_form.h2c: Use HTTP/2 for Plain HTTP Servers (h2c)
http_form.h2c_hint: HTTPS servers negotiate HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1 automatically. Plain HTTP servers receive HTTP/1.1, unless this option is on. Turn it on only when every plain HTTP server of this proxy accepts HTTP/2 with prior knowledge. WebSocket and other upgrade requests always use HTTP/1.1.
http_form.header_rules_hint: One rule per line: set Name: value, append Name: value or remove Name. Values can use {client_ip}, {host}, {scheme}, {request_id}, {route}, {client_cert_subject} and {client_cert_fingerprint}. Write {{ and }} for a literal brace. Request rules change the request to the upstream server. Response rules change the upstream response.
http_form.error_pages_hint: Serve custom HTML error pages for specific status codes (e.g. 404, 502) instead of the default error pages.
http_form.error_page_theme_hint: Select a platform-wide Error Page Theme to serve consistent error pages across your routes. Specific error pages defined below will override the theme for their status code.
http_form.dynamic_variables_hint: The engine replaces these tokens in custom HTML templates at runtime before sending the response to the client.
http_form.invalid_error_page_status: Status code must be between 400 and 599
http_form.error_page_empty_preview: Enter HTML code or select a template to see a live preview.
http_form.maintenance_body_hint: HTML or plain text response. Leave empty to serve the default maintenance page.
http_form.maintenance_body_placeholder: Optional custom HTML or plain text message...
http_form.maintenance_hint: Returns an immediate maintenance response instead of routing to upstream servers.
http_form.mirror_hint: Every mirror server receives a copy of the mirrored requests, with the same method, headers, path and body. r3v3rs3 drops the responses of the mirror servers, does not retry them and does not wait for them, so the client receives the response of the route server as before. A request whose body is larger than Maximum Body Size is not copied. A copy is sent after r3v3rs3 reads the whole request body. Cached responses, upgrade requests and requests over 64 copies in progress on the route are not copied. The copies carry the credentials that authentication does not remove.
http_form.override_body_limit: Override Request Body Limit for This Route
http_form.override_bot_blocker: Override Bot Blocker for This Route
http_form.route_bot_blocker_hint: Overrides the proxy bot blocker setting for this route.
http_form.route_grpc_web_hint: Overrides the proxy gRPC-Web setting for this route.
http_form.override_concurrency_limit: Override Concurrency Limit for This Route
http_form.override_headers: Override Header Rules for This Route
http_form.override_ip_filter: Override IP Filter for This Route
http_form.override_rate_limit: Override Rate Limit for This Route
http_form.override_timeouts: Override Upstream Timeouts for This Route
http_form.path_rewrite_hint: By default, the route path is removed, e.g. /api/users on the /api route goes to the server as /users. Turn off Remove Route Path to keep it. Then the regex replaces its first match in the path, which starts with /, with Replacement. ${1} or ${name} inserts a capture group. Then Add Prefix goes before the path. Authentication and the cache use the path of the client request.
http_form.preserve_path: Append the request path and query to the target
http_form.rate_limit_hint: Requests allowed for each client IP address. Clients over the limit receive 429 Too Many Requests. Set Requests to 0 to disable the limit. Set Burst to 0 to use the Requests value.
http_form.redirects_hint: One rule per line: status, regex and target, e.g. 301 ^example\.com/old/(.*)$ https://example.com/new/${1}. The regex matches the host without the port, the path and the query, e.g. example.com/old/page?id=1. ${1} or ${name} inserts a capture group. The status is 301, 302, 307 or 308. The first matching rule answers before authentication, and the request does not reach an upstream server. The IP filter, the rate limit and the HTTPS redirect run first. Write \s for a space in the regex and %20 in the target.
http_form.require_client_cert_hint: Reject requests matching this route unless the client presented a verified TLS client certificate (mTLS).
http_form.retries_hint: Attempts is the number of tries of one request, including the first try. Set it to 1 to disable retries. Each retry goes to the next upstream server of the route, and the request timeout applies to each try. A failed connection is retried for every method. A timeout and a 502, 503 or 504 response are retried only for GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT and DELETE requests. A request with a body is retried only when its length is known and at most Replay Body Limit bytes, because r3v3rs3 keeps the body in memory. Upgrade requests are not retried.
http_form.route_access_list_hint: The IP filter and the authentication of the selected access list replace those of the proxy for this route.
http_form.route_auth_hint: This route uses this authentication instead of the proxy authentication. Select None to allow every client.
http_form.route_body_limit_hint: This route uses this limit instead of the proxy limit. Set it to 0 to disable the limit for this route.
http_form.route_concurrency_limit_hint: This route uses its own concurrency limit instead of the proxy limit. Set Max to 0 to disable the limit for this route.
http_form.route_headers_hint: This route uses these rules instead of the proxy rules. Leave both lists empty to change no headers on this route.
http_form.route_ip_filter_hint: This route uses these lists instead of the proxy lists. Leave both lists empty to allow every client.
http_form.route_rate_limit_hint: This route uses its own counter instead of the proxy counter. Set Requests to 0 to disable the limit for this route.
http_form.route_retry_hint: This route uses these retry settings instead of the proxy retry settings.
http_form.route_timeouts_hint: This route uses these timeouts instead of the proxy timeouts.
http_form.routes_hint: A request goes to the route with the longest matching path, e.g. /api/users goes to /api before /. A proxy whose virtual host is equal to the request host wins over a wildcard, a regex pattern and a proxy without virtual hosts. The order of the routes does not matter.
http_form.servers_required: Enter at least one server, or select another route type.
http_form.sticky_hint: The first response to a client sets a cookie that names the upstream server of the route. The next requests with the cookie go to that server while the server is healthy and its circuit is not open, also when its weight is 0. Otherwise the load balancing policy selects the server, and the response sets a new cookie. The cookie value is signed, and the upstream server does not receive the cookie. After a restart of r3v3rs3, the old cookies are invalid. Set Cookie Max-Age to 0 for a cookie that ends with the browser session.
http_form.target_hint: Enter one upstream server URL on each line. To give a server a weight, write the weight after the URL, e.g. https://a.example.com/backend 3. The proxy selects a server for each request with the load balancing policy. An http+srv or https+srv URL, e.g. http+srv://_http._tcp.app.example.com/, takes its servers and their weights from the DNS SRV records of the name.
http_form.timeouts_hint: Connect Timeout limits the DNS lookup, the TCP connection and the TLS handshake of a new upstream connection. Request Timeout limits the time until the response headers arrive, including a new connection. Set Request Timeout to 0 to disable it. Clients receive 504 Gateway Timeout when a timeout expires.
http_form.trust_cdn: Trust Client IP Headers from Known CDNs
http_form.trust_cdn_hint: Reads the real client IP from Cloudflare, Fastly, Amazon CloudFront, Bunny CDN, Gcore, KeyCDN, Imperva and Google Cloud Load Balancing edge servers.
http_form.trusted_proxies_hint: IP addresses or CIDR blocks of load balancers in front of r3v3rs3. Their X-Forwarded-For header is trusted.
http_form.vhosts_hint: You can use commas to list multiple names and regex patterns, e.g, example.com, *.test.example.com, ^([a-z]+\.)+example\.com$ .

ports.proxy_protocol_hint: A load balancer in front of r3v3rs3 sends the client address in a PROXY protocol header. A connection from a trusted address must start with a valid header, or r3v3rs3 closes it. r3v3rs3 does not read a header from other addresses.

ports.server_names_hint: When the client sends no SNI, r3v3rs3 selects a server certificate that has all these names. Use commas to list multiple names, e.g. example.com, *.example.com.

proxy_form.active_check_hint: A Check Interval above 0 starts the active check. For a TCP proxy, the check connects to each server. For a UDP proxy, it resolves the host name of each server. A server that fails the check stays unhealthy until a check passes. Set Check Interval to 0 to disable the check.
proxy_form.active_check_http_hint: A Check Interval above 0 starts the active check. The check sends GET to the Health Check Path from the root of each server. A 2xx or 3xx status passes the check. When the path is empty, the check opens a TCP connection. A server that fails the check stays unhealthy until a check passes. Set Check Interval to 0 to disable the check.
proxy_form.circuit_breaker_hint: The circuit of a server opens when a window has at least Minimum Requests requests and at least Failure Ratio percent of them failed. A failed request is a failed connection, a timeout or a 502, 503 or 504 response. An open circuit gets no traffic until Open Duration expires. Then one trial request tests the server: a success closes the circuit, and a failure opens it again. When every server of a route has an open circuit, clients receive 503 Service Unavailable.
proxy_form.circuit_breaker_tcp_hint: The circuit of a server opens when a window has at least Minimum Requests connections and at least Failure Ratio percent of them failed to connect. An open circuit gets no new connections until Open Duration expires. Then one trial connection tests the server: a success closes the circuit, and a failure opens it again. When every server has an open circuit, the client connection closes.
proxy_form.client_cert_hint: r3v3rs3 sends this certificate to TLS upstream servers that ask for a client certificate. The list shows the client certificates that have a private key. A client certificate that a proxy uses cannot be deleted.
proxy_form.connect_timeout_hint: Limits the DNS lookup, the TCP connection and the TLS handshake of an upstream connection. The client connection closes when the time expires.
proxy_form.health_check_hint: A server is unhealthy after Max Fails consecutive failures. A failure is a failed connection or a request without a response. An unhealthy server gets new traffic only after the healthy servers until Fail Timeout expires. When every server is unhealthy, the proxy still uses them. Set Max Fails to 0 to disable the check.
proxy_form.invalid_server: Enter a valid host and port.
proxy_form.invalid_weight: Weight must be a whole number from 0 to 65535: {value}
proxy_form.load_balancing_hint: Round robin uses the servers in turn, each server as often as its weight. Random selects a random server, and a server with a higher weight is selected more often. First healthy server uses the other servers only as backups. Client IP hash sends each client IP address to the same server while that server is healthy. A server with weight 0 gets no new traffic. When the connection fails, a request without a body, a TCP connection or a UDP session goes to the next server once.
proxy_form.percent_range: {name} must be a whole number from 1 to 100
proxy_form.preset_hint: A template fills the first route. You can change every field after that.
proxy_form.proxy_protocol_hint: Sends the client address to each upstream server in a PROXY protocol header before the data of the connection. Enable it only when every upstream server reads the header. The active health check sends a version 2 LOCAL header.

proxy_form.session_idle_timeout_hint: Each client address has its own session. A session closes when no packet passes in either direction for this time.
proxy_form.max_datagram_size_hint: The largest UDP packet payload size in bytes (between 512 and 65527). Packets exceeding this size are truncated.
proxy_form.datagram_size_range: Maximum datagram size must be a whole number of bytes from {min} to {max}
proxy_form.srv_weight: An SRV server URL has no weight. The SRV records give the weights.
